pages.description: An Angry Birds character stands among ancient ruins on this printable coloring page, framed by broken columns, a damaged arch, and cracked stone walls with trailing ivy. Its large oval belly fills much of the foreground. The coloring sheet includes narrow column grooves, small leaves, and scattered masonry around the bird.

pages.title: Angry Birds in Piggy Village Coloring Page
pages.description: This Angry Birds printable coloring page shows an upright bird in Piggy Village, standing on a plank walkway between timber houses with thatched roofs and stone foundations. A pig in a hard hat peeks from behind a fence. The coloring sheet includes smaller window frames, roof edges, and a tiny potted plant.

pages.title: Angry Birds in Red's Village Coloring Page
pages.description: An Angry Birds character stands on a winding path in Red's Village on this printable coloring page, between small wooden cottages, rounded trees, and short fences. A blank signpost sits beside the path. Broad feather areas dominate the coloring sheet, with narrower boards, roof lines, and foliage around the village houses.

pages.title: Angry Birds on Riverbank Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features an Angry Birds character on a riverbank, with folded wings, oval cheek patches, and large feet beside the curving water's edge. Low hills and bushes line the opposite shore. The coloring sheet has broad body spaces, small shoreline pebbles, and simple ripples across the river.

pages.title: Angry Birds on Alien Planet Coloring Page
pages.description: A round Angry Birds character stands on an alien planet in this printable coloring page, with unusual spotted plants, jagged cliffs, and a large ringed world overhead. Small stars dot the open sky around the bird. The coloring sheet combines wide body areas with crater shapes, plant markings, and angular rocks.

pages.title: Angry Birds in Golden Egg Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: This Angry Birds printable coloring page places a round bird inside the Golden Egg Cave, with a cluster of eggs, hanging stalactites, and cracked rocks nearby. Its pointed beak and angled eyebrows face forward beneath a two-feather crest. The coloring sheet leaves broad spaces across the bird and smaller sections along the cave walls.

pages.title: Angry Birds in Frozen Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: An Angry Birds character wears a long striped scarf in a frozen valley on this printable coloring page, surrounded by snowflakes, pointed mountains, and snow-covered fir trees. The scarf wraps around its neck with two ends hanging over the belly. The coloring sheet includes narrow scarf bands and larger snowy slopes.

pages.title: Angry Birds on Pirate Ship Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows an Angry Birds pirate aboard a ship, wearing a skull hat and eyepatch while holding a curved sword and a hook. A large sail, ship's wheel, and cannon surround the bird. The coloring sheet includes broad sail panels and smaller rope loops, deck boards, and costume details.

pages.title: Angry Birds in Egg Nest Area Coloring Page
pages.description: An Angry Birds character sits behind three large eggs in a nest on this printable coloring page, with its pointed beak above the central egg. Thick overlapping twigs form the nest's circular rim. The coloring sheet keeps the background open, setting broad egg and body shapes against the narrower spaces between the sticks.

pages.title: Angry Birds on Sandy Beach Coloring Page
pages.description: This Angry Birds printable coloring page features a bird standing on a sandy beach, with two seashells near its feet and gentle waves behind its body. Distant palm trees and rounded clouds complete the shoreline scene. The coloring sheet offers broad feather areas alongside smaller shell ridges and simple water lines.

pages.title: Angry Birds on Slingshot Hill Coloring Page
pages.description: A round Angry Birds character waits in a wooden slingshot on this printable coloring page, above rolling hills with a small cluster of rocks near the base. Wide elastic bands loop between the forked arms around the bird. The coloring sheet has large open slopes and finer wood-grain lines along the slingshot.

pages.title: Angry Birds in Lava Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places an Angry Birds character on a rock platform inside a lava cave, surrounded by dripping flows, rounded bubbles, and jagged walls. Heavy eyebrows and a pointed beak dominate the bird's face. The coloring sheet combines open body sections with irregular lava shapes and smaller circular surface details.

pages.title: Angry Birds in Harbor Town Coloring Page
pages.description: An Angry Birds character stands in a harbor town on this printable coloring page, with sailboats, waterfront houses, and a striped lighthouse across the water behind it. Several small seabirds fly beneath rounded clouds. The coloring sheet includes broad feather spaces and narrower sections in the boat rigging, windows, and hull planks.

pages.title: Angry Birds in Carnival Grounds Coloring Page
pages.description: This Angry Birds printable coloring page shows a round bird at carnival grounds, with a Ferris wheel, a striped tent, and strings of triangular flags behind it. A small booth and round path lights surround the foreground. The coloring sheet includes broad face areas, narrow tent panels, and smaller wheel cabins and pennants.

pages.title: Angry Birds in Wooden Tower Area Coloring Page
pages.description: An Angry Birds character occupies a plank platform in a wooden tower area on this printable coloring page, with pigs and other birds in nearby timber structures. A slingshot rises above one tower, and stacked blocks sit beside the central bird. Rough boards, support beams, and uneven steps add detailed sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Angry Birds in Treehouse Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page brings five Angry Birds characters around a treehouse, with one bird waving from the doorway and others perched on the surrounding branches. The timber house has a thatched roof, shuttered windows, and wooden steps. Leaf clusters, railings, and small feather shapes make this a detailed group coloring sheet.
